title: Three arrested in connection to Oconee Co. assault, attempted murder - NewsBreak
text:
By Hallie Shuler No media credit provided. ,
11 hours ago
OCONEE COUNTY, S.C. (WSPA) – The Oconee County Sheriff’s Office have arrested three in connection to an assault and attempted murder that took place late Monday.
The sheriff’s office said that late Monday evening, deputies responded to a call at Davis Hill Road, near Thrasher Road, in reference to an assault. Deputies located an adult male victim, who said that two men got out of a vehicle and assaulted him. The victim also stated the two suspects returned to their vehicle, and attempted to run him over before fleeing the scene.
During the investigation, authorities located the vehicle at at Boomdocks Drive near Walhalla, which was at the time operated by a woman identified as 28-year-old Tabatha Marie Moore. Deputies said Moore had methamphetamine on her person, and was arrested and charged with possession of methamphetamine and accessory before the fact of a felony.
Deputies located the two suspects, identified as 34-year-old Aaron Scott Gunn and 20-year-old Carter Lewis Deaton-Crooks, on Tuesday August 26. Gunn was charged with second degree assault and battery by mob, and Deaton-Crooks was charged with second degree assault and battery by mob.
Authorities claim that Moore provided her vehicle as transportation for herself, Gunn and Deaton-Crooks to locate and assault the victim. Gunn had struck the victim in the head and torso with spiked brass knuckles. Moore was also allegedly a passenger in the vehicle at the time of the assault.
Moore, Gunn and Deaton-Crooks are currently held in the Oconee County Detention Center under bond.
The incident remains under investigation by the Oconee County Sheriff’s Office.
